title: The Captain's Ledger
summary: Osric Hale pays for the bright-eyed ones out of his own purse when Lord Pellam's coin is late, and writes every one down. He has a page with room for three more.

steps.journal: Put down three of the bright-eyed ones in the Old Barrows. They come to lead every fifth wave.

objectives.label: Elites slain in the Old Barrows

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at the Watch post by the well.
done: Three more lines in the Captain's ledger, all of them paid.
